Welcome to my portfolio!

My official name is Xiyuan Liu, but just Amy sounds good as well. I am a undergraduate rising senior at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu), majoring in Engineering with a concentration in electrical and computer engineering and a minor in Philosophy.

I enjoy exploring a broad range of electrical engineering fields from hardware design and testing to embedded systems. Outside of engineering, I spend my free time creating digital art and watching anime.

If you have any questions or suggestions regarding the contents of this site, feel free to contact me at amyliu01@g.hmc.edu.
